name: Voxfor Advanced Price Management For WooCommerce
author: voxfor

sections.description:
Voxfor Advanced Price Management For WooCommerce is the ultimate solution for store owners, wholesalers, and retailers who need powerful, flexible, and efficient pricing workflows. Whether you’re managing hundreds or thousands of products, this plugin streamlines your pricing operations with professional-grade tools.

Perfect for:
* E-commerce stores with large product catalogs
* Wholesale businesses with complex pricing structures
* Retailers managing seasonal price adjustments
* Distributors handling multiple supplier price lists
* International stores requiring VAT/tax calculations

Transform your pricing workflow from manual, time-consuming updates to automated, intelligent price management. Say goodbye to spreadsheet headaches and hello to streamlined pricing operations that save hours of work while reducing errors.

The plugin features a modern, intuitive interface that makes complex pricing operations simple and efficient. With real-time previews, intelligent calculations, and comprehensive reporting, you’ll have complete control over your product pricing strategy.

Resources

  • Official Website
  • Documentation
  • Watch Full Video Guide

Key Features

🚀 Advanced CSV Management
* Drag & drop CSV import with intelligent file validation
* Comprehensive CSV export functionality for backup and analysis
* Support for UTF-8 encoding and international characters
* Smart error detection and detailed processing reports

💼 Direct Product Management
* Intuitive bulk selection interface with search and filtering
* Real-time price calculation with live preview
* Support for simple products and variable product variations
* Professional tabbed interface for organized workflow

🧮 Intelligent Price Calculations
* Configurable markup percentages with instant preview
* Flexible VAT/tax calculations for international compliance
* Real-time formula display showing calculation breakdown
* Price increase tracking and session-based change monitoring

⚡ Smart Product Handling
* Intelligent SKU generation and matching algorithms
* Automatic detection of product types (simple/variable/grouped)
* Session tracking to prevent accidental duplicate updates
* Support for WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS)

🎨 Professional User Experience
* Modern, responsive interface design
* Clear visual feedback and progress indicators
* Comprehensive error handling with helpful guidance
* Full internationalization and translation-ready support

Requirements

  • WordPress version 6.0 or above
  • WooCommerce version 8.0 or above
  • PHP version 7.4 or above
sections.installation:
Automatic Installation (Recommended)
1. Log in to your WordPress admin dashboard
2. Navigate to Plugins → Add New
3. Search for “Voxfor Advanced Price Management”
4. Click Install Now and then Activate
5. Go to WooCommerce → Price Management to start using the plugin

Manual Installation
1. Download the plugin zip file
2. Upload the voxfor-advanced-price-management folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
3. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen in WordPress
4. Navigate to WooCommerce → Price Management to configure and start managing prices

Getting Started
After installation, you’ll find the plugin under WooCommerce → Price Management in your admin menu. The interface provides two main tabs:
* CSV Import/Export: For bulk price updates via CSV files
* Direct Management: For selecting and updating individual products directly
sections.faq:
What format should the CSV file be?

The CSV file must contain at least two columns: SKU and Catalog Price. The SKU column should match your WooCommerce product SKUs exactly. Additional columns are ignored, so you can use existing supplier price lists without modification. The plugin supports UTF-8 encoding for international characters.

How do markup and VAT calculations work?

The plugin uses a simple formula: Final Price = (Catalog Price + Markup%) + VAT%. You can configure both percentages in the settings, and the plugin shows a real-time preview of calculations before applying changes. For example, with 20% markup and 10% VAT: a $100 catalog price becomes $132.

Can I update variable products?

Yes! The plugin supports both simple products and variable product variations. When working with variable products, you can update individual variations by their specific SKUs, giving you granular control over variant pricing.

What happens if a SKU isn’t found?

Products with unmatched SKUs are automatically skipped and listed in the detailed report. The plugin never creates new products – it only updates existing ones, ensuring your catalog structure remains intact.

Can I undo price changes?

While there’s no automatic undo feature, we recommend exporting your current prices via CSV before making bulk changes. This creates a backup you can re-import if needed. The plugin also tracks which products were updated during each session.

Is the plugin compatible with other WooCommerce extensions?

Yes, the plugin is designed to work with standard WooCommerce pricing and is compatible with most themes and extensions. It supports WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS) and follows WordPress coding standards.

How do I handle international characters in SKUs?

The plugin fully supports UTF-8 encoding and international characters. It includes intelligent SKU generation that converts special characters to URL-friendly formats (e.g., “Ñoño” becomes “nono”) while maintaining product matching accuracy.

Can I see a preview before updating prices?

Absolutely! Both the CSV import and direct management interfaces show real-time previews of price calculations. You can see exactly what the new prices will be before confirming any changes.

1.1.2

  • Added session tracking with visual indication for updated products
  • Prevented duplicate updates during a single session
  • Added “Price Increase” column showing calculated increase
  • Improved SKU format to lowercase-with-dash (e.g., sing-161)
  • Added session counter and manual session clearing
  • Improved CSV import interface with format guidance
  • Disabled checkboxes for variable products (only variations are editable)

1.1.1

  • Added WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS) compatibility
  • Made base price field non-editable in Direct Update interface
  • Filtered out external and grouped products from Direct Update view

1.1.0

  • Added Direct Product Management with selection and tabbed UI
  • Enabled real-time calculation and visual preview
  • Improved product selection UI and added Select All functionality
  • Support for simple and variation products

1.0.1

  • Improved error handling and CSV compatibility
  • Enhanced support for UTF-8 encoding and variable products

1.0.0
